items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

ctx.x: You know I was trying to think what was Jeannette's last name before she was married. I never died. Stokes. Stokes. Yeah. She was from uptown wasn't she. Here on this side of the river and all. Oh you're a chick Jeanette. Where were they raised? Right down here. Right down in here. Oh in here. I thought maybe uptown. No they were but they moved uptown. But they came from down here then. This side.
